settings.general.account.perks-history-d: Games that aren't tied to an account are cleaned up after about a year.
settings.general.account.perks-intro: Signing in is free. It just makes Firestone work better for you.
settings.general.account.perks-lottery-d: Points still accrue locally; sign in to sync them and enter at the end of the season.
settings.general.account.perks-replays-d: Without an account, replay files are removed after 60 days.
settings.general.account.perks-sync-deta: Match history, pack stats, and achievements stay with you when you reinstall or switch computers.
settings.general.launch.replay-ftue-tool: Show the first-time setup again. Choosing an experience level will update overlay settings.
settings.general.launch.restore-ftue-set: Restore the settings from before the last introduction profile?
Put back the overlay settings you had before you last applied an introduction profile. Later profile changes do not overwrite this backup.
settings.general.localization.ai-text: When enabled, missing translations are filled with AI-generated text. Community translations always take priority. AI strings may be imperfect, and English is still used if no AI translation exists.
settings.general.localization.ai-toggle-: Fill untranslated strings with AI-generated text. Community translations always take priority.
